Лука апостол и јеванђелист.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank, and «апостол и јеванђелист» is the pair of grades this corpus keeps in `types`, so all of it comes off and the bare personal name is the whole of the form; the heading gives him no epithet and no see. `foldchk.py` measured the string as held by `doukas-the-tailor` in sr and `luke-of-bathys-ryax` in ru before this day, so this form takes that fold to three folders and the key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Λουκάς ο Ευαγγελιστής»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry is the evangelist: of Antioch in Syria, Greek by nationality, a physician who also knew the painter's art, to whom the first icons of the Mother of God with the infant Christ are ascribed — «μία υπάρχει μέχρι σήμερα στη Μονή του Μεγάλου Σπηλαίου» — and those of the Apostles Peter and Paul; catechised by Paul, whom he met at Thebes, and the writer of the third Gospel and of the Acts. **No `dates` proposed**: the page gives him no year of birth or death — «Λέγεται ότι πέθανε με μαρτυρικό θάνατο (κατ' άλλους ειρηνικά σε ηλικία 80 ετών)» is a manner of death and an age, not a year, and the 357 it does give is the translation of his relics to the church of the Holy Apostles in Constantinople. The first Ἀπολυτίκιον and the Κοντάκιον are taken and both name him; the three «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» (one of them composed by Metropolitan Synesios of Thebes, 1912–1944) and the Οἶκος are not drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 31.10.2026 (18. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. Лука апостол и јеванђелист.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry and the longest of the three. The heading is quoted whole, with the closing full stop the Prologue prints, which is BRIEF-SERBIAN section 4; «апостол и јеванђелист» in it is the `apostle` and the `evangelist` this folder already holds in `types`, so nothing is added there, and «љекар» in the body is the `physician` and the icon-painting the `iconographer`, both of which it holds as well. This entry calls him ТHE FOUNDER OF CHRISTIAN ICONOGRAPHY outright. `dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THREE NUMBERS REFUSED. This folder holds no `dates` at all and still holds none. The entry gives «написао Јеванђеље, око 60. године» — a YEAR FOR THE GOSPEL and not for the man; «Беше му 84 године, када га... обесише» — AN AGE, which is refused and may not be subtracted from anything; and the translation of the relics «у време цара Констанција, сина Константиновог», which is A REIGN and not a year. None of the three is a birth or a death, and nothing was derived from them by arithmetic. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. He was FROM ANTIOCH and learnt Greek philosophy, MEDICINE AND PAINTING well in his youth. HE CAME TO JERUSALEM WHILE THE LORD WAS STILL AT WORK ON EARTH, saw the Saviour face to face, heard his teaching and witnessed his miracles; believing, he was NUMBERED AMONG THE SEVENTY and sent out to preach. He was the one who saw the risen Lord on the road to Emmaus with Cleopas. After Pentecost he returned to Antioch and became the fellow-worker of the apostle Paul, travelling with him as far as Rome; the entry quotes Colossians 4:14 for it, «Поздравља вас Лука љекар љубазни». After Paul’s martyrdom he preached THROUGH ITALY, DALMATIA, MACEDONIA and other parts. HE PAINTED AN ICON OF THE MOST HOLY THEOTOKOS — AND NOT ONE BUT THREE — and icons of the apostles Peter and Paul as well. In old age he visited LIBYA AND UPPER EGYPT, and came back from Egypt to Greece, where he went on preaching with great zeal in spite of his great age. He dedicated BOTH the Gospel AND the Acts to THEOPHILUS, PRINCE OF ACHAIA. He was eighty-four when the idolaters HANGED HIM ON AN OLIVE TREE in the city of Thebes in Boeotia. NO NEW `related`, AND TWO NAMES DELIBERATELY NOT LINKED. Paul and Cleopas are both in this entry and this folder already relates both; Peter is named only as the subject of an icon, which is a dedication and not a companion, and Theophilus of Achaia and the emperor Constantius are named and no folder read here is either of them. THE FOLD THIS FORM MAKES: «Лука» was held by `doukas-the-tailor` in sr and `luke-of-bathys-ryax` in ru, a pair the gate was printing as UNREAD; this form makes it three folders, so a three-folder key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit and there was no narrower key to delete. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

english.text: O holy Apostle and Evangelist Luke, entreat the merciful God to grant our souls forgiveness of sins.

hymns.text: Ἀπόστολε Ἅγιε, καὶ Εὐαγγελιστὰ Λουκᾶ, πρέσβευε τῷ ἐλεήμονι Θεῷ, ἵνα πταισμάτων ἄφεσιν, παράσχῃ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’ — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιος Λουκάς ο Ευαγγελιστής», and it names him.

english.text: Holy Apostle and Evangelist Luke, intercede with the merciful God, that he may grant our souls the forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Μαθητὴς γεvόμενος τοῦ Θεοῦ Λόγου, σὺν τῷ Παύλῳ ἅπασαν, ἐφωταγώγησας τὴv γῆν, καὶ τὴν ἀχλὺν ἀπεδίωξας, τὸ θεῖον γράψας, Χριστοῦ Εὐαγγέλιον.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’. Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον — on the page of «Άγιος Λουκάς ο Ευαγγελιστής», and it names him.

english.text: Having become a disciple of God the Word, together with Paul you gave light to all the earth and drove the mist away, writing the divine Gospel of Christ.
